tasks.spec:
You are a repo fix worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the OBE podcast repo (/mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast) at HEAD — edit files here directly.

OWNERSHIP BOUNDARY: you own exactly two paths: scripts/obe_escalation_card.py and tests/test_obe_escalation_card.py. Nothing else. Never touch .git, never commit, never run git add; leave changes uncommitted.

CONTEXT — owner rule (Ankit 2026-08-05, verbatim): 'add a card polarity rule so approve never means stop.' Incident the same night: a card whose body read 'Approve = PAUSE the 10am publish' caused the owner to unwind a launch he wanted, because Approve had meant go on every other card. On any card this lane creates, Approve must map to the SAFE-FORWARD action; a stop/hold/destructive action must ride Respond with a typed word.

CHANGE (in scripts/obe_escalation_card.py): before invoking the ticket tool, lint the composed card body AND the escalation text for Approve mapped to a stop verb — case-insensitive, covering 'approve = <stop>', 'approve means <stop>', 'approve: <stop>', 'approve -> <stop>', 'approve to <stop>', '✅ approve — <stop>', with <stop> in: pause, stop, halt, hold, cancel, delete, remove, kill, unschedule, abort, revoke, suspend, disable, block, retract, withdraw (word boundary, tolerant of whitespace and an intervening 'the'). On detection: create NO card and send NO buzz; print a JSON line {"ok": false, "error": "card polarity violation: Approve must never mean '<verb>' — rephrase so Approve is the safe-forward action and the stop rides Respond with a typed word (owner rule 2026-08-05)"} and exit 1 so the caller's plain-text fallback fires (an alert is never lost, but no polarity-inverted buttons get armed). Constants at module level with a comment citing the rule and incident. Do not change any other behavior (ledger append, buzz, exit codes for the healthy path stay exactly as today).

TESTS (extend tests/test_obe_escalation_card.py in its existing monkeypatch style): (a) escalation text 'Approve = pause the 10am publish' => no ticket subprocess call, no ledger row, no buzz, exit 1, error mentions polarity; (b) the standard body this script generates for a healthy escalation ('YOUR MOVE: Approve = approve the <loop> loop escalation...') still passes the lint and cards normally — regression-pin that the lint does not flag the lane's own default wording; (c) text containing a stop verb NOT mapped to Approve ('ops will pause the old timer after you approve') is not flagged.

HOW TO RUN (from the worktree root — all must pass): PLACEHOLDER_MODE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_obe_escalation_card.py -q -p no:cacheprovider && python3 -m py_compile scripts/obe_escalation_card.py

HARD RULES: smallest diff, no reformatting, stub all transport in tests, never invoke any network, model CLI, MCP, or skill, leave changes uncommitted — the harness exports the diff.
